items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Yeah I was with Joe Benoit even. With Joe Benoit and Fort Al, and I think what was a four piece or five pieces out there with Joe Benoit. Fort Al, Albert Warner's son, and Albert Warner, and Herman Antwine.
